title: Internal memo: Julia Liuson, head of Microsoft's developer division, will resign after 34 years and move to an "advisory role" at the end of June (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Internal memo: Julia Liuson, head of Microsoft's developer division, will resign after 34 years and move to an “advisory role” at the end of June — Veteran Microsoft executive Julia Liuson is leaving after 34 years. … Microsoft is losing another veteran executive.
